{{Top|leg}}
'''Shwpi''' were small phytophagous mammals native to the planet [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. They lived in rocky fissures and moved under the surface of sand. By an Imperial expedition to the planet they were noted as being "quite common" there.
